verdict.rationale: Chargebee's own docs describe official Chargebee MCP Servers that AI clients like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT and Codex can connect to. They also cover custom MCP servers built from Chargebee's full tool catalog, and a probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and evidence on setup and authentication details.
